# 4.3.1 (opens new window)

  • Fix type definition for arrayMerge options. #239 (opens new window)

# 4.3.0 (opens new window)

  • Avoid thrown errors if the target doesn't have propertyIsEnumerable. #252 (opens new window)

# 4.2.2 (opens new window)

  • isMergeableObject is now only called if there are two values that could be merged. a34dd4d2 (opens new window)

# 4.2.1 (opens new window)

  • Fix: falsey values can now be merged. #170 (opens new window)

# 4.2.0 (opens new window)

  • Properties are now only overwritten if they exist on the target object and are enumerable. #164 (opens new window)

Technically this could probably be a patch release since "which properties get overwritten" wasn't documented and accidentally overwriting a built-in function or some function up the property chain would almost certainly be undesirable, but it feels like a gray area, so here we are with a feature version bump.
